owner_text:
Genre: Mystery / Psychological Horror / Supernatural
Target duration: 1:15–1:20
Format: Vertical 9:16
Storytelling: First-person narration + character dialogue
Audience engagement: Viewers choose which door they would enter.

Main rule:
“Every midnight, three doors appear. You may enter only one. But whatever door you choose, you will lose one memory forever.”


THREE DOORS OPEN EVERY MIDNIGHT AND ENTERING ONE ERASES A MEMORY
1. CHARACTER DESIGN — KEEP CONSISTENT
IMPORTANT: All character appearances, clothes, accessories, proportions, and facial features must remain identical throughout the entire video.

ETHAN — Main Character
• Age: 16
• Messy black hair.
• Dark blue hoodie.
• Black pants and white sneakers.
• Brown eyes.
• Small bandage on his right cheek.
• Personality: Curious, emotional, brave but impulsive.
• Facial expressions: Confused, suspicious, terrified, regretful, heartbroken.

EMMA — Ethan’s Younger Sister
• Age: 9
• Shoulder-length blonde hair.
• Yellow sweater.
• Blue skirt and white shoes.
• Always carries a small white teddy bear.
• Personality: Innocent, playful, affectionate.
• Facial expressions: Happy, confused, frightened, loving.

THE DOORKEEPER
• Tall, unusually thin humanoid figure.
• Wears a long black coat.
• White featureless face with no visible mouth.
• Glowing pale blue eyes.
• Carries an old silver pocket watch.
• Moves slowly and unnaturally.
• Voice: Deep, calm, emotionless.

THE MOTHER — FLASHBACK
• Long brown hair.
• Beige cardigan.
• White blouse.
• Warm, gentle expression.
• Appears only in Ethan’s memories.

2. ENVIRONMENT AND WORLD DESIGN
LOCATION: THE FORGOTTEN HALLWAY
A mysterious hallway that appears inside Ethan’s house every midnight.

Environment details:
• Extremely long corridor.
• Black marble floor.
• Dark gray walls.
• Floating dust particles.
• Three enormous wooden doors.
• No visible windows.
• An old grandfather clock at the end of the hallway.
• Thick white fog covering the floor.

THE THREE DOORS
DOOR 1 — RED DOOR

• Dark red wooden texture.
• Small golden handle.
• Faint sounds of laughter behind it.
• Represents memories of happiness.

DOOR 2 — BLUE DOOR

• Dark blue wooden texture.
• Ice-covered edges.
• Faint sounds of someone crying.
• Represents memories of pain and loss.

DOOR 3 — WHITE DOOR

• Pure white surface.
• No handle.
• Soft golden light coming from underneath.
• Represents memories you haven’t experienced yet.

IMPORTANT: Each door must be visually distinguishable in every shot. Never change their colors or positions.

3. COMPLETE SCRIPT
SCENE 1 — THE HOOK
TIME: 0:00–0:09

LOCATION: The Forgotten Hallway — Midnight.

CAMERA AND ACTION:
1. Start with a completely black screen.
2. A loud grandfather clock strikes twelve.
3. Quick cut to three enormous doors appearing inside a dark hallway.
4. Camera rapidly pushes toward the doors.
5. A frightened boy stands in front of them.
6. Close-up of his trembling hand reaching toward the red door.
7. Suddenly, a shadowy figure appears behind him.

LIGHTING:
• Red light illuminates Door 1.
• Blue light illuminates Door 2.
• Soft golden light illuminates Door 3.
• The rest of the hallway remains almost completely dark.

SOUND DESIGN:
• Three deep clock strikes.
• Low atmospheric rumbling.
• Faint whispering coming from behind the doors.

NARRATOR (ETHAN) — urgent, mysterious, frightened:
“Every midnight, three doors appear in my hallway. You can enter only one. But whichever door you choose… you lose a memory forever.”

TRANSITION: Fast zoom toward Ethan’s eyes.

SCENE 2 — THE WARNING
TIME: 0:09–0:22

LOCATION: The Forgotten Hallway.

CAMERA:
• Medium shot of Ethan slowly stepping backward.
• The Doorkeeper emerges from the darkness.
• Low-angle shot makes the Doorkeeper appear extremely tall.
• Close-up of his silver pocket watch.
• The clock reads 11:59 PM, despite the hallway already appearing at midnight.

DOORKEEPER — deep, emotionless voice:
“Choose carefully, boy. One door will show you happiness. One will show you pain. And one will show you what you have yet to lose.”

ETHAN — confused, nervous:
“What happens if I don’t choose?”

DOORKEEPER — slowly turning his head:
“Then the doors will choose for you.”

ACTION:
The three doors suddenly shake.

SOUND: Three heavy wooden knocks.

SCENE 3 — THE FIRST MEMORY
TIME: 0:22–0:35

LOCATION: Directly in front of the RED DOOR.

CAMERA:
• Ethan slowly approaches Door 1.
• The golden handle turns by itself.
• The door opens slightly.
• Warm light spills into the dark hallway.
• A flashback appears.

FLASHBACK LOCATION: Ethan’s childhood living room.

VISUAL:
• Young Ethan and Emma are playing together.
• Their mother sits on a couch, laughing.
• Emma hugs Ethan.
• Their mother calls them both to dinner.

MOTHER — warm, loving voice:
“Come on, you two. Dinner is ready!”

NARRATOR — nostalgic, emotional:
“Behind the red door was my happiest memory. A time when my family was still together.”

ACTION:
• Ethan smiles.
• A tear slowly forms in his eye.
• The memory begins fading.

DOORKEEPER — whispering:
“Enter… and you will never feel that happiness again.”

SCENE 4 — THE SECOND MEMORY
TIME: 0:35–0:48

LOCATION: Directly in front of the BLUE DOOR.

CAMERA:
• Ethan turns toward Door 2.
• A cold breeze blows through the hallway.
• The blue door slowly opens.
• Camera moves inside.

FLASHBACK LOCATION: Hospital corridor — Rainy evening.

VISUAL:
• Young Ethan sits alone outside a hospital room.
• His mother is lying in a hospital bed.
• Emma is crying while holding his hand.
• Ethan looks down, unable to speak.

NARRATOR — sad, hesitant:
“Behind the blue door was the worst night of my life. The night I lost my mother.”

ETHAN — quietly, with trembling lips:
“I don’t want to remember that night anymore.”

DOORKEEPER — emotionless:
“Pain is still a memory, boy. And memories are what make you who you are.”

CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Ethan’s eyes.

SCENE 5 — THE THIRD DOOR
TIME: 0:48–1:02

LOCATION: Directly in front of the WHITE DOOR.

LIGHTING:
• Soft golden light.
• Floating white particles.
• The hallway becomes strangely silent.

CAMERA:
• Ethan slowly approaches the white door.
• It opens without anyone touching it.
• Inside is a bright living room.
• An older Ethan is sitting with a little girl.
• The girl looks exactly like Emma.

FUTURE EMMA — smiling:
“You’re late, big brother!”

NARRATOR — shocked, confused:
“Behind the white door was a memory I had never lived. A future where Emma was still beside me.”

ETHAN — whispering:
“Is that… my future?”

DOORKEEPER:
“Some memories haven’t happened yet. But you can still lose them.”

SCENE 6 — THE REALIZATION
TIME: 1:02–1:12

LOCATION: The center of the hallway.

CAMERA:
• Ethan turns toward the Doorkeeper.
• Close-up of the pocket watch.
• The watch reveals three small photographs.
• Each photograph shows Ethan with his mother and Emma.
• Ethan looks at the Doorkeeper.

ETHAN — emotional, angry:
“Why do you keep taking people’s memories?”

DOORKEEPER — slowly lowering his head:
“Because people would rather forget their pain than remember the people they loved.”

ACTION:
• Ethan looks at all three doors.
• He steps away from them.
• The Doorkeeper tilts his head.

ETHAN — determined, emotional:
“Then I choose none of them.”

SCENE 7 — THE TWIST AND ENDING
TIME: 1:12–1:20

LOCATION: The Forgotten Hallway — Midnight.

CAMERA:
• The Doorkeeper suddenly becomes completely still.
• The three doors begin disappearing.
• The grandfather clock stops ticking.
• Extreme close-up of the Doorkeeper’s glowing eyes.

DOORKEEPER — almost whispering, surprised:
“You’re the first person who ever refused.”

VISUAL:
• Ethan wakes up in his bedroom.
• Morning sunlight enters through the window.
• He sees an old photograph of his mother and Emma beside his bed.
• He smiles and holds it close.

NARRATOR — calm, emotional, meaningful:
“I finally understood. You don’t have to erase painful memories to move forward. Sometimes, remembering is how you keep the people you love alive.”

FINAL ON-SCREEN TEXT:
“IF YOU HAD TO CHOOSE, WHICH DOOR WOULD YOU ENTER?”

COMMENT PROMPT:
“RED ❤️ | BLUE 💙 | WHITE 🤍 | NONE”

END.
